editorial_policy: Opportunities are sourced from authoritative organisations and classified by lifecycle. Expired or closed opportunities remain in the archive and are removed from active listings; they are never silently deleted.

records.title: GEF-7 FOLUR Mt. Elgon Direct Beneficiary Grants — coffee, maize and nature-based livelihoods
records.eligibility: Eligible registered local organisations operating in the specified Bungoma and Trans Nzoia target sub-counties, including farmer cooperatives, producer organisations and community-based organisations.
records.summary: Financial support for viable nature-positive livelihood enterprises linked to coffee, maize, diversification and indigenous-community livelihoods in the Mt. Elgon landscape.

records.title: IFAD Support for Food Systems Transformation in the Central Sahel
records.eligibility: Eligible institutions able to implement the requested regional food-systems transformation activities; applicants must follow the official IFAD call documentation.
records.summary: IFAD invites eligible institutions to submit proposals for a USD 2 million regional initiative supporting food-systems transformation in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger. The official call sets a submission deadline of 16 October 2026 at 23:59 GMT.
records.notes: Institutional/consortium call, not a direct grant for individual farmers. Confirm all eligibility requirements in the official call documents before applying.

records.title: SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility — 2nd Call
records.eligibility: SIFAZ-supported farmers, cooperatives and eligible SMEs in Zambia's promoted legume value chains.
records.summary: Matching grants supporting mechanisation enterprises, input acquisition and marketing, commodity aggregation and green enterprises. The published second-call deadline was 5 June 2026.

records.title: AfDB CAWMA — climate-adapted agricultural productivity and water management
records.summary: African Development Bank approved a Malawi programme focused on climate-adapted agricultural productivity through improved water management.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for Enhancing Climate-Adapted Agricultural Productivity Through Improved Water Management (CAWMA), supporting climate resilience and improved water management for smallholder communities in Malawi.

records.title: AfDB Rice Agro-Industrial Special Zone Project — Phase I
records.summary: AfDB-approved investment supporting Sierra Leone's rice agro-industrial special zone development.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for Sierra Leone's Rice Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zone (SLERAZ) Phase I, supporting rice productivity, climate-resilient production, mechanisation and agro-industrial value chains.

records.title: AfDB Cashew Development Programme Phase II preparation
records.summary: AfDB-approved preparation support for Zambia's Cashew Development Programme Phase II.
records.description: African Development Bank's Zambia country portfolio page lists the approved Cashew Development Programme Phase II Preparation Project (P-ZM-AA0-057). This country portfolio page is used because a stable direct project page was not confirmed; verify the project listing and current status at source.
records.notes: Country portfolio link rather than a confirmed direct project page; verify the Cashew Development Programme Phase II Preparation Project listing and current status before publication.

records.title: AfDB Agricultural Climate Resilient and Vulnerability Reduction Project
records.summary: AfDB-approved project supporting agricultural climate resilience and vulnerability reduction in Zimbabwe.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for Zimbabwe's Agricultural Climate Resilient and Vulnerability Reduction Project, supporting drought-affected rural communities, sustainable grazing and water resources, and agricultural input supply chains.

records.title: AfDB Boosting Agrifood Systems Resilience in Sudan
records.summary: AfDB-approved programme focused on strengthening agrifood systems resilience in Sudan.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for BOOST in Sudan, supporting food production, agrifood-system resilience and agribusiness opportunities for women and youth.

records.title: FARM-TRAC — family farming, regional markets and cross-border trade corridors
records.eligibility: Eligible organisations meeting IFAD grant requirements and able to implement regional activities in the Sahel/West and Central Africa.
records.summary: Three-year IFAD grant supporting inclusive territorial development, family farming, jobs for women and youth, nutrition, climate-resilient technologies and cross-border agricultural trade.
records.notes: Archived historical call only. The official IFAD page states the submission deadline was 23 September 2019; do not present this as an active funding opportunity.

records.title: Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing Mechanism (ACFM)
records.summary: African Development Bank facility providing concessional debt and grant-based technical assistance to catalyse investment in African agri-food SMEs, including investment readiness, project preparation and climate/gender advisory support.

records.title: Nigeria AgriConnect Compact — agriculture and agribusiness transformation framework
records.summary: Nigeria framework involving FMAFS, World Bank, IFAD and partners to strengthen farmer organisations, market linkages, finance and digital solutions across priority value chains.

records.title: AfDB Technical Support to the Horticulture Supply Chain for Smallholder Farmers
records.summary: AfDB-approved technical support project for Nigeria's horticulture supply chain and smallholder farmers. This is project/investment intelligence, not a public grant application.
records.description: African Development Bank project record for HORTISUN, a technical-assistance project in Kaduna State focused on strengthening the tomato supply chain, reducing post-harvest losses and improving market access for smallholder farmers and MSMEs.

records.title: AfDB BOI Green Growth Technical Assistance for SMEs
records.summary: AfDB-approved technical assistance supporting green-growth finance for Nigerian SMEs. This is investment/finance intelligence; eligibility and access depend on the implementing institution.
records.description: African Development Bank project record for technical assistance to the Bank of Industry's SME green-growth financing capacity, including agro-food processing and other eligible SME sectors. This is programme information, not a direct farmer loan application.

records.title: AfDB Trade Finance Facility for SMEs and Other Businesses in Benin
records.summary: AfDB-approved trade-finance facility supporting SMEs and businesses in Benin. This is finance-programme intelligence rather than a direct individual grant.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for the €25 million trade-finance facility supporting NSIA Banque Benin's financing of eligible local SMEs and businesses, including agribusiness and equipment-import activity. It is not a direct grant application.

records.title: AfDB Distributed Renewable Energy Agriculture Modalities (DREAM) Programme
records.summary: AfDB-approved programme linking distributed renewable energy modalities with agricultural development in Ethiopia.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for Ethiopia's DREAM programme, integrating renewable-energy mini-grids with irrigation and productive agricultural demand. This is project information, not a direct farmer grant application.

records.title: AfDB Regional Program for Rice Development in West Africa (REWARD) — G2
records.summary: AfDB-approved regional rice-development programme supporting rice value-chain investment in West Africa.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for the Regional West Africa Resilient Rice Value Chains Development Project (REWARD-Ghana), a regional rice value-chain programme with Ghana as the named country component.

records.title: AfDB Lower Mangoky Irrigation Area Extension Project — Phase II
records.summary: AfDB-approved irrigation investment for the Lower Mangoky area, strengthening agricultural water infrastructure and productive capacity.
records.description: African Development Bank project page for Madagascar's Lower Mangoky Irrigation Area Extension Project Phase II, supporting irrigation-area development in the Atsimo-Andrefana region.

records.title: IFAD–AgDevCo blended financing for Africa's next generation of agribusinesses
records.summary: US$10 million IFAD loan agreement with AgDevCo to mobilize financing for early-stage African agribusinesses, with emphasis on locally owned and women-led enterprises.

records.title: IFAD–Equity Group climate adaptation finance mechanism
records.summary: US$200 million mechanism designed to expand climate-adaptation finance to smallholder producers and rural enterprises in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda.

records.title: IFAD–Bank of Kigali financing for farmers' organizations
records.summary: US$12 million financing agreement aimed at expanding access to finance for Rwanda's farmers' organizations.

records.title: Somalia Women’s Market Access Innovation Challenge
records.summary: IFAD and the Government of Somalia supported innovative businesses improving women's access to agricultural markets, finance and business opportunities.
